title: Making of that part of periodical record which relates to landowners (Mutations / Intiqal)
verbatim_text: (1) Any person acquiring, by inheritance, purchase, mortgage, gift or otherwise, any right in an estate as a landowner, or a tenant for a fixed term, shall report his acquisition for the purpose of entering mutation to the Patwari of the estate within three months from the date of such acquisition. (6) A Revenue Officer shall, in the presence of the parties and local persons in an open Assembly (Jalsa-e-Aam), verify and sanction or reject the mutation.

title: Presumption in favour of entries in Records-of-Rights and periodical records (Fard / Jamabandi)
verbatim_text: Any entry made in a Record-of-Rights in accordance with the law for the time being in force, or in a periodical record in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter and the rules made thereunder, shall be presumed to be true until the contrary is proved or a new entry is lawfully substituted therefor.

title: Application for partition of holding (Agricultural Land Partition)
verbatim_text: Any joint owner of land, or any joint tenant of a lease holding from a landlord, in respect of which no order of ejectment has been passed, may apply to a Revenue Officer for partition of his share in the land or tenancy, as the case may be, if: (a) at the date of the application the share is recorded under Chapter VI as belonging to him; or (b) his right to such share has been established by a decree which is still subsisting at that date; or (c) a written acknowledgment of that right has been executed by all persons interested in the admission or denial thereof.

title: Exclusion of jurisdiction of Civil Courts in matters within the jurisdiction of Revenue Officers
verbatim_text: (1) Except as otherwise provided by this Act, no Civil Court shall have jurisdiction in any matter which the Board of Revenue or any Revenue Officer is empowered by this Act to dispose of or take cognizance of. (2) A Civil Court shall not exercise jurisdiction over: (xviii) any claim for partition of an estate, holding or tenancy, or any question connected with, or arising out of, proceedings for partition, not being a question as to title in any of the property of which partition is sought.
